say:1:1310917001:1.text: How come you're here, Brother Callahan? Aren't you supposed to be at St. Kinga's Temple?
say:1:1310917001:1.source_cn: 噢，杨凯维奇兄弟，你怎么突然到访？你不是应该回圣金嘉教堂吗？

say:2:1310917002:1.text: That's the reason why I'm here. Something's happened. We have urgent matters to tell the Hierophant.
say:2:1310917002:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，圣金嘉教堂出事了，我正是因为此事而来的！我和...

say:3:1310917003:1.text: His Excellency hasn't been in great health lately... Therefore, we have suspended all religious activities to allow the Hierophant to rest and heal in peace.
say:3:1310917003:1.source_cn: 大主教阁下身体状态……不太好。正因如此，我们最近暂停了...

say:4:1310917004:1.text: No wonder there's no one here. Can we meet His Excellency? Our magister is a great mage who knows a lot of healing magic.
say:4:1310917004:1.source_cn: 怪不得都没有人呢，那我们能见见大主教阁下吗？我的主人是...
say:4:1310917004:1.male: No wonder there's no one here. Can we meet His Excellency? Our magister is a great mage who knows a lot of healing magic.
say:4:1310917004:1.female: No wonder there's no one here. Can we meet His Excellency? Our magister is a great mage who knows a lot of healing magic.

say:5:1310917005:1.text: ... We have acolytes who are skilled at healing. The Hierophant does not want his illness to spread to others, and he needs peace and quiet to recuperate.
say:5:1310917005:1.source_cn: ……我们有擅长治疗的修士，大主教阁下不希望他的病传染给...

say:6:1310917006:1.text: But something bad has happened! Cultists were performing Hypogean rituals in the other temples. There's also a time loop in Cedartown.
say:6:1310917006:1.source_cn: 可是这里出了大事！有邪教徒在教堂里进行恶魔崇拜的仪式，...

say:7:1310917007:1.text: Everything's gone nuts! We need to see the Hierophant and let him know what's going on!
say:7:1310917007:1.source_cn: 这些情况太不正常了，我们需要见大主教，得让他知道这一切！

say:8:1310917008:1.text: Hypogean rituals? Time loops? What are you babbling about?
say:8:1310917008:1.source_cn: 恶魔仪式？时间循环？你们在说什么啊，没有在开玩笑吗？

say:9:1310917009:1.text: Brother Zaneus, I saw two Hypogean altars at the other temples with my own eyes! Please let us speak with His Excellency. He needs to know what's happening.
say:9:1310917009:1.source_cn: 兹比格涅夫兄弟，我亲眼见到了两座恶魔祭坛！请让我们觐见...

say:11:1310917010:1.source_cn: 请让我们进去吧，修士先生！

say:12:1310917011:1.text: *Sigh*... I apologize. The rules of the temple are very strict. I cannot disregard the edict being enforced. Guests cannot be allowed in.
say:12:1310917011:1.source_cn: 唔……很抱歉，修道院的纪律很严格，我不能违背，因此无法...

say:13:1310917012:1.text: However, Acolyte Callahan is one of our own, so I can make an exception and allow him to meet with the Hierophant.
say:13:1310917012:1.source_cn: 但杨凯维奇兄弟是本院修士，我可以网开一面，允许他面见大...

say:15:1310917013:1.text: It's up to you, Callahan. Tell him what's happening.
say:15:1310917013:1.source_cn: 看来我们是没法进去了……杨凯维奇先生，拜托你了！

choice_prompt:16:1310917013.text: It's up to you, Callahan. Tell him what's happening.
choice_prompt:16:1310917013.source_cn: 看来我们是没法进去了……杨凯维奇先生，拜托你了！

say:17:1310917014:1.text: Rest assured. I will report everything that happened in full to His Excellency.
say:17:1310917014:1.source_cn: 各位放心，我会将之前的事情完完整整地向大主教阁下汇报的。

narration:19:1310917015:1.text: The two acolytes enter the temple together, and the heavy doors of the temple are closed.

say:21:1310917016:1.text: What course lies before us now?

say:22:1310917017:1.text: I think we should go to Cedartown again.
say:22:1310917017:1.source_cn: 我觉得……我们应该再去雪松镇看看！

say:23:1310917018:1.text: If the previous two rituals were really related to the time loop and we destroyed the altars, Cedartown should return to normal. That's my hypothesis.
say:23:1310917018:1.source_cn: 如果之前的两个邪恶仪式真的和时间循环有关，我们破坏了仪...

say:24:1310917019:1.text: Hammie's usually right. Let's go check it out.
say:24:1310917019:1.source_cn: 说得有道理！那我们现在就去吧！

choice:16:0:1.text: We'll leave the Hierophant to you.
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 事态严重，请一定告知大主教
choice:16:0:1.male: We'll leave the Hierophant to you.
choice:16:0:1.female: We'll leave the Hierophant to you.
